title: Moving grasp handover
summary: A long bar-shaped part is already riding a powered roller conveyor when the episode starts. The left arm must grasp it with its gripper while it is still moving and lift it, then carry it, still moving, through a presentation point. It then hands the part over to the right arm: both grippers hold it at the same time, then the left gripper opens wide and lets go while the right one keeps holding it. Finally the right arm must lay the part into a long open slot that slides back and forth on a rail and let go of it, so that the part lies in the slot while the slot is moving.
robot_setup: Two Pandas with their standard two-finger grippers and no tool. panda-0 (left): base at (-0.55, -0.23, 0), yaw 0 (facing +x). panda-1 (right): base at (0.74, 0.23, 0), yaw pi (facing -x). Each arm's tool frame is its gripper TCP (the point between the fingertips). At the start both TCPs point straight down (TCP z = world -z, and TCP x = world +x for both arms), so the fingers close along world y. Left TCP at (-0.10, -0.10, 0.20); right TCP at (0.19, 0.16, 0.23). Both grippers start partly open at 0.024 m per finger (0.048 m total aperture). The action's last entry is the total aperture in [0, 0.08] m, and each finger moves at most 0.025 m/s. In this task the fingers follow their own trajectory, not synchronized with the arm joints, so an aperture change does not stretch the duration of the arm motion. Role labels per phase (left, right): moving_pickup: moving_grasper, preparing_receiver; moving_presentation: moving_donor, tracking_receiver; overlapping_grips: donor_grip, receiver_grip; donor_release: releasing_donor, sole_support; receiver_slot_delivery: cleared_donor, slot_deliverer.
scene: An orange bar-shaped part (0.22 x 0.034 x 0.036 m, long axis along world x) lies across a short roller conveyor. The conveyor has 20 grey rollers (radius 6 mm, 136 mm long, axes along x, 12.5 mm apart along y) on a pedestal, all motor-driven so that their tops carry the part along +y. The part is longer than the rollers and overhangs them at both ends. At t = 0 the part is already moving along +y with the conveyor. The conveyor keeps running for the whole episode, and nothing stops the part at its end: a part that is not taken is carried off the end and falls. A blue open box, the 'slot' (0.25 m along x by 0.13 m along y inside, 0.06 m deep), rides a straight rail along y. The slot is driven back and forth along the rail in a smooth sinusoidal oscillation by itself for the whole episode: slowly, and slowest where it turns around. The table top is the world's z = 0 plane.
scene_privileged: Conveyor: fixed articulation centred at (-0.08, -0.08, 0.10). Roller axes are at z = 0.108 (roller tops at z = 0.114), roller centres at y = -0.08 + (i - 9.5) x 0.0125 for i = 0..19 (from -0.19875 to +0.03875), each roller spanning x in [-0.148, -0.012]; roller friction 0.9. Each roller has a velocity drive toward -`incoming_speed` / 0.006 rad/s about +x (surface speed `incoming_speed` = 0.08 m/s toward +y at the top), with damping gain 0.012 and torque limit 0.008 N m, and is already spinning at that speed at reset. Part: box with half extents (0.11, 0.017, 0.018) m, mass 0.065 kg (fixed in code; `object_mass` is not used), friction 0.8, restitution 0.05. At reset its centre is at (-0.08, y0, 0.133) with y0 ~ U(-0.15, -0.12) (first draw), unrotated, with velocity (0, `incoming_speed`, 0). Slot: prismatic fixture, rail centre (0.24, 0.03, 0.10), axis +y, limits +-0.5 m; inside 0.25 x 0.13 m, 0.06 m deep, inner floor at the link origin (z = 0.10), moving mass 0.3 kg. A PD drive (kp 80, kd 8, force limit 8 N) tracks q*(t) = q0 + 0.20 sin(w t) with velocity target `fixture_speed` cos(w t), where w = `fixture_speed` / 0.20 = 0.175 rad/s (period about 35.9 s). q0 ~ U(-0.06, -0.02) m is the second draw at reset; the initial velocity is `fixture_speed` = 0.035 m/s along +y. This is an oscillation of 0.20 m amplitude about q0 with peak speed `fixture_speed`. Its target speed exceeds 0.02 m/s only while |cos(w t)| > 0.02 / `fixture_speed` = 0.571: at this instance t < 5.5 s and 12.45 s < t < 23.45 s. Slot world y = 0.03 + q. No other random values; nothing is drawn after reset. Table friction `table_friction` = 0.08. `radius`, `preview`, `restitution` and the `tool_*` parameters are not used by this task. Horizon `horizon` = 25 s.

phases.name: moving_pickup
phases.text: the left gripper grips the part (both left-arm fingers, finger links or pads, are in contact with it) at a moment when the part moves faster than 0.025 m/s; this is recorded once. After that, with the left grip still holding, the part's centre rises above z = 0.21 m.

phases.name: moving_presentation
phases.text: while the left gripper still grips the part (both fingers in contact), the part's centre comes within 0.07 m of the presentation point (0.09, 0.05, 0.24) at a moment when the part moves faster than 0.015 m/s.

phases.name: overlapping_grips
phases.text: both grippers grip the part at the same time (both fingers of each hand in contact with it) for 0.08 s without interruption.

phases.name: donor_release
phases.text: the right gripper grips the part (both fingers in contact), no left-arm finger touches the part, and the left gripper is open wider than 0.065 m (sum of its two finger positions), all for 0.12 s without interruption.

phases.name: receiver_slot_delivery
phases.text: the part lies in the moving slot, and the slot moves along its rail faster than 0.02 m/s, for 0.7 s without interruption. The part touches the slot, and neither gripper grips it (a single finger may still touch it). In the slot's frame its centre is within 0.014 m of the slot centre along x (the slot's long axis), within 0.045 m along y, and between 0.01 m and 0.06 m above the slot floor. It moves at less than 0.05 m/s relative to the slot. This completes the task.

task_failures: handover_drop: during moving_presentation, overlapping_grips or donor_release, the part's centre drops below z = 0.13 m.
contact_rules: There are no tools. The fingers of either gripper (finger links and pads) may touch the part and nothing else: not the conveyor rollers or frame, not the slot or its rail, not the table. No other robot part (hand or arm links) may touch anything, the part included. The two arms may never touch each other, finger to finger included, and no arm may touch itself.
world_goals_fixed: Presentation point (0.09, 0.05, 0.24) for the part's centre (moving_presentation), announced at reset as `goal_target`. Lift height: part centre above z = 0.21 m (moving_pickup). Drop limit: part centre must stay at or above z = 0.13 m during moving_presentation, overlapping_grips and donor_release.
difficulty_note: Everything happens on the move. The grasp must close on a part that the conveyor is carrying toward its end, and the presentation point must be passed while the part is moving. The handover needs a brief overlap of two independent grippers on one bar without dropping it. The final release must put the bar into a slot that leaves only a small margin along its long axis, while the slot keeps moving and reverses direction.
standard_notes: At t = 0 the part is already riding the conveyor toward its end and the slot is already moving; both keep going without any action, and the rollers spin for the whole episode. If the part is not grasped in time, it falls off the conveyor's end. The slot is too slow for the last phase near its turning points, so when the delivery can succeed depends on how long the earlier phases took.
